title: Last Window: The Secret of Cape West
subtitle: Kyle Hyde returns to another troubled address
summary: Last Window: The Secret of Cape West is Cing's Nintendo DS adventure following former detective Kyle Hyde a year after Hotel Dusk. Set in Los Angeles in December 1980, it places him inside the Cape West Apartments and another mystery connected with the people around him and his own past. The handheld is again held vertically like a book, giving conversations and drawn characters a distinctive presentation across its screens. Investigating an ordinary building gradually reveals a history that its residents have different reasons to explain, protect or leave unspoken.
body: Last Window: The Secret of Cape West is Cing's Nintendo DS adventure following former detective Kyle Hyde a year after Hotel Dusk. Set in Los Angeles in December 1980, it places him inside the Cape West Apartments and another mystery connected with the people around him and his own past. The handheld is again held vertically like a book, giving conversations and drawn characters a distinctive presentation across its screens. Investigating an ordinary building gradually reveals a history that its residents have different reasons to explain, protect or leave unspoken.

Conversations introduce an Ignore option, allowing Kyle to let a line of questioning pass when pursuing it would be unhelpful. Deciding what to follow therefore becomes as important as finding something to ask. An ill-judged statement, a suspicious possession or being discovered where he should not be can bring the investigation to an early end. The system gives encounters a social risk alongside the search for clues. Reading another person's reaction helps the player decide when to press forward and when leaving a subject alone is the more useful response.

Completing a chapter opens another section of an in-game novel also called Last Window. Its account complements the events being played, with decisions affecting the material presented in the book. The device connects the handheld's book-like orientation with something that can actually be read after the investigation has moved on. Small optional activities offer further details of the period and the building's everyday life. The result gives Kyle's progress another form, allowing the same mystery to accumulate as both a sequence of conversations and an unfolding written record of the journey.

A useful question is not always the next one
The investigation leaves a book behind
